overall_goal: Prepare and add garam masala powder to the dish

goals.description: Retrieve and arrange ingredient jars and packets on the countertop
goals.rationale: The person gathers various jars and spice packets, including the garam masala, and organizes them on the counter for use.

goals.description: Open the bag of garam masala powder
goals.rationale: The person removes the rubber band sealing the garam masala bag and pulls the opening apart to make it accessible.

goals.description: Scoop and add the garam masala powder
goals.rationale: The person uses a tablespoon to scoop the garam masala powder from the bag and adds it to the masala plate.
